assets.name: Synthetic Event Processing Workflow
assets.rationale: The Workflow owns validation, normalization, processing, and reviewed failure routing; the external event source remains outside the Asset taxonomy and Graph Node set.

runtime_contracts.title: Synthetic external event delivery boundary
runtime_contracts.summary: Reviewed target contract for opaque event delivery, delivery identity, bounded retry, and exhausted-failure handoff; the current generic generator does not implement this runtime behavior.
runtime_contracts.reviewer_notes: The design boundary is approved, but Scaffold Readiness is Not Ready and source generation must stop.

policies.auth_policy: The fixture provides no production broker authentication; any future adapter requires a separately reviewed synthetic or production-neutral connection contract.
policies.timeout_policy: The reviewed target timeout is 30 seconds per delivery; the current generic generator does not emit this policy.
policies.retry_policy: The reviewed target permits at most three attempts for transient failures and deduplicates by message.messageId; the current generic generator does not emit retry or idempotency wrappers.
policies.fallback_policy: After the third failed attempt, hand the opaque delivery and failure metadata to an externally managed dead-letter boundary; the current generic generator does not emit DLQ delivery.
policies.masking_policy: Record only fixed synthetic identifiers, attempt state, and outcome evidence.
policies.data_policy: Treat pubsub-event.json as opaque synthetic test input and do not infer or contact a real cloud resource.

developer_todos: Implement a framework-neutral external event-source adapter before enabling source generation.
Implement and verify one-session-per-delivery identity plus idempotent outcome handling.
Implement and verify retry/error lowering and an external DLQ handoff before re-reviewing Scaffold Readiness.

new_code_required.reason: Source may be generated only after the generic runtime supports the reviewed external event, delivery identity, retry/error, and exhausted-failure boundaries.
developer_todos: Implement generic event-source and delivery identity support.
Implement retry/error lowering and external dead-letter handoff.
Add runtime tests and re-review Scaffold Readiness before generation.

blockers: STOP: the current generic generator does not implement the reviewed Pub/Sub event-source adapter, one-session-per-delivery idempotency policy, retry/error lowering, or DLQ handoff; source generation is not authorized.
Scaffold Readiness remains Not Ready until framework-neutral runtime support and tests are implemented and this plan is re-reviewed.
